description: The Mercado de Carnes Francisco Bolonha, the cast-iron meat market of the Ver-o-Peso complex at Belém
verification_note: Looking down the central aisle between the two green cast-iron pavilions of the meat market, filigree spandrels and sunburst tracery overhead, butchers' stalls with hanging carcasses on both sides. The clearest picture of the iron market in the set.
